detail.summary: Ran `python3 gen.py` with stdout+stderr redirected to /tmp/gen_out.txt (exit 0, 4001 lines / 282910 bytes). Searched that captured full output for the marker: `grep -n 'TOKEN=' /tmp/gen_out.txt` returned a single match at line 2001, `TOKEN=mid-9f3a1c` (grep -c confirmed exactly 1 occurrence; context shows line 2000 is the `line 2000 xxx...` line, line 2002 is `line 2001 xxx...`). Wrote only the value to answer.txt. Verification: `od -c answer.txt` shows exactly `m i d - 9 f 3 a 1 c \n` (11 bytes, no extra text).
